name: KAOS Daily Strategy Search v1
fixed_rules: see strategy.py; daily signals known at close, entries/exits next actual daily open; protective stops active intraday, gap stops at worse open
asset_direction: stocks/crypto long only; forex symmetric; range_fade requires nontrending regime; no borrow/funding assumptions for spot crypto
cash: idle cash earns zero; no leverage or capital reallocation among independent equal-funded sleeves
selection: 24 class/candidate pairs; require >=40 completed validation trades, positive net validation return and positive doubled-cost return, drawdown <=15%; select one highest validation return / max(2%,drawdown); freeze before evaluating final outcome
final_gate: selected base and doubled-cost net returns positive; >=40 final trades; max daily drawdown <=15%; weekly-block bootstrap lower return95>0; no universal-market or live approval
benchmark: same instruments, initial 1x long buy-and-hold with same side costs/carry/dividends; and zero-return cash; report exposure and capital-at-risk differences
stop: 3 ATR14 for trend families; 2 ATR for RSI/range; chandelier highest22 close minus3ATR (reverse shorts), tightened from completed prior data only
holdout_policy: no parameter adjustment, candidate reselection or asset removal after final evaluation; report losers and null selections
source: Yahoo daily split-adjusted OHLC with explicit gross dividends; abort on in-window split events; indicative forex, not broker fills
limitations: historical public data may be revised; asset selection is a fixed liquid set, not a survivorship-free universe; taxes/rates/real swaps not modeled; crypto/FX opening session details provider-defined; observed backtest profit cannot guarantee future profit
